While the Pose Auditor found high confidence keypoints, this often happens when the model 'guesses' the location of obscured joints. The visual ambiguity here is a classic AI generation weakness in handling complex occlusions. I maintain the severity at 2.0 as it disrupts the physical grounding of the subject.

The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions, and the Topology Auditor confirmed a single coherent mask, which supports the idea that these are localized issues rather than catastrophic failures.
